verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1632). Measures the consequence by running the shipped key function: captureWindowKey (transpiled from lib/engagement/capture.ts) gives a repeatable node different keys on two days and one key for a same-day double tap, and gives once_per_user and once_global nodes one key across days; captureNode reads capture_rule and the server-resolved member day and writes the node_capture ledger row under that window key, never the bare node:<nodeId>:<actorProfileId>. Fails on main (3be7bedd4) at the first arm. Mutation-fired: 6 of 6 (no capture_rule read, a device/UTC day, a ledger key off the window, always bare, a nonce per call, every rule daily) fail it. Exits 79 when the file is gone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1632). PREMISE HELD on main at 3be7bedd4: captureNode keyed every node_capture ledger row on node:<nodeId>:<actorProfileId>, and verifyCapture lets a repeatable node through, so the ledger collapsed every later scan as already_captured before the captures insert and the zap award; a Space check-in node (created repeatable) counted a member's first check-in only. WHAT CHANGED. lib/engagement/capture.ts exports captureWindowKey: once_per_user and once_global nodes keep <nodeId>:<actor>; a repeatable node appends the member's own calendar day, resolved on the server by resolveMemberDay (home_timezone, else UTC), never sent by the device. captureNode reads capture_rule with the node and keys the ledger (node:<window>) and the Space check-in timeline (checkin:<window>) on it. practice.verified and the in_person_checkin trust signal stay once per (node, actor). No economy value moved (zaps_value is per node and unchanged). No migration. docs/ENGAGEMENT-MECHANICS.md updated. TESTS: lib/engagement/capture-window.test.ts (two scans on two days credit twice and log twice; a same-day double tap credits once; a once-per-user node stays at one credit across days); mutation-checked (a bare key fails the two-day test).
